utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive is moving along, so I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Ira. I like having a clear update, so I’ll check in with you once I know more.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good, Eli. I’ll keep checking while I’m out and let you know if I hear anything new.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great. Please bring the drill and the new screws.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, I’ll bring the drill and the screws.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You mean the repair drive is still on for today, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, it’s still on, but I’m a little worried about whether we’ve got enough people and time to finish everything today.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, it’s still on for today?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I’m a bit fuzzy on the details, but I’m here to help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Oren. I can fill you in: the repair drive still needs supplies and a couple of hands, so I’ll keep track and let you know what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Perfect, I’ll keep an eye out for what’s still needed and I can lend a hand when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Can you remind me what’s included in the repair drive? I want to make sure I have the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I think it’s mostly tools, paint, and the stuff for patching the front steps. I might be forgetting one or two things, though.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps. Can you double-check whether there was also anything for cleaning up the steps or just the tools, paint, and patching supplies?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late, what’s left to do on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Mostly the big stuff is done, but we still need a few hands for sorting supplies and fixing the porch rail. Want to grab a task?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I can take the porch rail if you want.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with that. What part of the repair drive do you need a hand with?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to. I can take a look at the electrical side or the mechanical parts, whichever you need first.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can check the repair drive location if you want, but I don't have it yet.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I still don’t have the repair drive location, but I can keep looking.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive’s picking up speed now; I heard they’ve got more volunteers than they expected. Folks around here are really showing up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I know, it’s great to see. I’m telling a few more folks about it right now so we keep that momentum going.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s the spirit. I’ll spread the word too, and maybe we’ll get a few more hands over before the day’s out.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time does the repair drive start?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It starts at 9 a.m.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can help with that repair drive, Nell. I’ll repeat the plan to anyone who asks.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it, thanks. I’ll pass it along if anyone asks.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure thing, I’ll keep repeating the repair drive plan if anyone asks.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Uli. I’ve got the repair drive list ready, and I’ll coordinate the next round so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, I’ll keep the list moving and make sure we have a clear check-in before the next round.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up this afternoon, and folks are bringing tools by the community hall. Eli, if you need help, I can point you to the right people.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d appreciate that, Tess. I’ll head over this afternoon and see what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, I’ll keep an eye out for you this afternoon. If you see the group at the community hall, ask for Mara or Len and they’ll point you to the jobs that still need doing.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what’s left on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Not much left now, just the last few repairs and a quick cleanup. We’re close.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Nice, I can help with the cleanup or the last repairs.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Just a pair of hands and a quiet hour would help. I can manage the rest.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds good. I’ll come by for the quiet hour and lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can help with the repair drive. What’s the first thing you need?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sure - what can I pick up first?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can grab the small stuff first: screws, wood glue, and some sandpaper.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help with that repair drive — what’s still needed?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, I’m checking what’s left first so I don’t miss anything. What parts of the repair drive still need attention?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help sort that out with you - tell me what’s already been checked, and I’ll help figure out what still needs attention.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive. I think I saw a note about that somewhere, but I missed the details.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I think there’s a note posted by the community board with the details. I can check it and let you know what time and what kinds of repairs they’re looking for.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, thanks — if you hear the time and list of repairs, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, right, the repair drive — I heard they’re still collecting donations at the shop on Maple. I can swing by after errands and tell you what I find out.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Ira. I’ve got a drill and a couple wrenches I can bring by if they need them.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’d be a big help. I’ll check what they still need at the shop and let you know after I’m back.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with that.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, I’ll bring the repair drive by tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, I’ll look it over when you drop it off tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: We should probably check who can actually take the repair materials and when, so we don't end up short on anything.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Who can take them, and what time do you need them moved?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: We can probably move them this afternoon, but I need to know exactly who has a vehicle and whether the load fits before we commit.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, you should come by the repair drive this Saturday — we could use another set of hands.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure, I can help with that.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll see you Saturday then.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with the repair drive after I check the school schedule. Just tell me what time you need me.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Faye. After school works best for me - maybe around 4?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 4 works for me after I check the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Nell. I’ve got the repair drive list ready, and I’ll make sure everyone knows where to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I’ll help where I can, and I’ll ask around if I hear anything more about the list.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Nell. I’ll keep you posted if anything changes, and your help on the list would be a big help.
